unlisted_practices: Model serum calcium as a perioperative trajectory across at least three time points using time-series regression or mixed-effects models rather than a single static threshold.

Incorporate systemic inflammation and nutritional indices such as C-reactive protein, procalcitonin, neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio, and the systemic immune-inflammation index into the predictive model.
Include omitted clinical variables such as tumor distance from the dentate line in the predictive model.
Conduct prospective validation of the prediction model across more diverse cohorts.
Integrate the prediction tool into clinical workflows in real time with electronic medical record linkage and alerts.
